items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: It was Rudy Wiedoft played with Paul Whiteman who's one of the finest alto players in the country... And these two guys supposed to be the best.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
My oldest brother, Bill -- William McRae, he played piano and arranged. My second oldest brother, Floyd McRae, now, he was a tremendous alto player.
It was Rudy Wiedoft played with Paul Whiteman who's one of the finest alto players in the country...
